Amends the seed rule just sent. Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "i wil lnote that you may say play A v B and they might have dfiferent numbers of seeds", "i think in that case were just doing different modulo arithmetic." Partners are by index, not equal seed value: order each job's launched seeds (ascending seed), let n = max(|A|, |B|); pair k in 0..n-1 is A[k mod |A|] vs B[k mod |B|]; a point's games split evenly over the n pairs (remainder to the lowest k). Every seed of both jobs plays, and equal counts give seed i vs seed i. A=3, B=2, games=1000: A0-B0 334, A1-B1 333, A2-B0 333. No "no equal seed" gap. Seed sets fixed at launch, so the plan is known before checkpoints arrive; a later seed changes n and replays that job's points. The Seating stays seed-free.
